notes: JUDGEMENT (recorded): additive arity-3 carrier. The spec's §8.2/§16 C1 is n-generic ('Square residual R : R^n -> R^n', PointCert { box_: IBox }), while the frozen shim's PointCert.box_ is IBox2 (already consumed by identity.rs/engine.rs/fixtures). This packet lands the n=3 spelling as the standalone additive type PointCert3 (box_: IBox3) without changing PointCert, exactly the recorded deviation class used for PsiMapKind. engine.rs's module-level 'no typed Proven carrier yet' prose is left as the pre-packet record (append-only work); krawczyk_c1_n3's own doc comment records that this packet now supplies the typed carrier.

The R8-shaped known-root fixture is a raw SquareResidualEval (no R8System - that is S1A's): the line C(t) = (t, t, t - 1) pierces the plane S(u,v) = (u, v, 0) exactly at (t,u,v) = (1,1,1); H(t,u,v) = (t - u, t - v, t - 1) with constant Jacobian [[1,-1,0],[1,0,-1],[1,0,0]] (det = 1, transverse C' not in the tangent plane). The box [0.9,1.1]^3 is centred on the root and certifies Proven with rho <= RHO_MAX.

krawczyk_c1_n3 replicates krawczyk_c1's op order at n=3 over CertifiedInterval (every op widened by next_down/next_up): midpoint-Jacobian interval inverse via adjugate over determinant, K = z - A R(z) + (I - A DR(B))(B - z), strict-inside/disjoint/overlap classification, and Lemma 8.0's rate rho = max_i (M r)_i / r_i. Backing table parity is pinned by the test mirroring the 2D entries: disjoint image -> Disproven (ClaimRefuted, backing Disproven); boundary-touching non-strict image -> Inconclusive (the outward-rounded point interval straddles the boundary, so it is Overlap, never Disproven).

The no_transcendental_call_in_engine_module scan still passes after the append (the added code performs no sin/cos/atan2/exp/ln/log/powf and no sqrt), so the N4 bit-reproducibility record of engine.rs is preserved.
